q1_issues.issue: No Name atom is emitted for any of the proper nouns present ("Banach", "Mackey", "Arens"), though *Names and casing* makes the name-derived symbol and its single Name fact both mandatory and non-optional.

The lowercase common noun "topology" is folded into the name-bearing symbol and then given a compound genus, but *Compound concepts* states that nothing in that section applies to a proper noun — the capitalized run alone is the symbol and its kind belongs in a separate ordinary type atom (the "Brindle estuary" pattern).
(Inheritance weak_arens_space_topology weak) exposes a modifier genus on a symbol built around the proper noun "Arens", barred by the same "no genus and no modifier atoms" rule for names.

q2_gaps: a frequency adverb over a habitual whose subject is a specific/definite named referent rather than a bare-plural kind — the strength channel is specified only for a distributing rule or "a flat generic", so putting 0.1 directly on individual event atoms is an unspecified extension

the downtoner "relatively" on a frequency adverb — the strength table gives bare "rarely" = 0.1 and there is no carrier for the hedge (Degree is for adjectives and quantity, not for a frequency adverbial)
notes: The verbal side is right: distributive replication over the coordinated subjects, agentless passive omitting the Agent, Theme for "use" (explicitly listed), no tense atom for the habitual present, and strength 0.1 plus the QuantifierPhrase companion for the frequency adverb; the deviations are confined to the named-term encoding.
